threshold_agreement.policy: The VALID/VALID route is not accepted without an explicit agreement result.

aggregation.REPRESENTED: Every maximal authoritative rule is defined, at least one returns RELATES, and none returns DOES_NOT_RELATE.
aggregation.NOT_REPRESENTED: Every maximal authoritative rule returns DOES_NOT_RELATE.
aggregation.UNDEFINED: A maximal rule is unresolved, maximal rules conflict, authority is incomparable without policy, or maximality cannot be determined.
aggregation.lower_authority_guard: Lower-authority rules may be ignored only under explicit governed precedence.

explicit_empty_policy.context: For a required context component, empty mapping is MISMATCH only when the domain explicitly defines absence as rejection; otherwise UNDEFINED.

context_rule_sets.MaximalApplicableContextRuleSet_x: Apply maximal-authority and conflict semantics independently to all three components.

legacy_alias_policy.OrientCarrierBridge_x: LEGACY_PROJECTION_ONLY; active semantics operationalized by EvalOrientCarrierBridge_x.
legacy_alias_policy.SourceContextBridge_x: LEGACY_PROJECTION_ONLY; active semantics operationalized by EvalSourceContextBridge_x.

import_closure.supersedes_field_rule: supersedes_symbol_from identifies a symbol only; supersedes_source_artifact_id identifies an artifact.

next_action: Obtain independently governed mapping and dependency records after this governance layer is human-reviewed.
